title: Responsive Conference (Oakland Museum) — Eric joins the September 23–24 leadership convening
summary: Responsive Conference — the 275-person CHRO/CPO/founder convening established in 2016 from the Responsive.org manifesto — returns to the Oakland Museum of California with Eric on the speaker roster alongside Rebecca Hinds (Your Best Meeting Ever), Adam Rosendahl (Late Nite Art), Tony Levitan (Leaders in Tech), and A.C.T.@work.
blockquote: Established in 2016, Responsive Conference brings together 275 CHROs, CPOs, founders, and executives for an immersive two-day experience about work — built for leaders who want new ideas, tools, and a community that understands what it's actually like to lead amidst uncertainty.
attribution_title: Annual leadership convening, Oakland Museum of California
